description: Control plane homepage: global health, portfolio tiles, product catalog drill-down, health heatmap, and active incidents. RBAC-ready.

options.content:
# Data Marketplace  ·  Observability Platform

Real-time health across all data products — **SLA compliance**  ·  **freshness**  ·  **availability**  ·  **active incidents**.

Filter by **Environment · Portfolio · Domain · Owner** above  ·  Drill down: click any portfolio or product name  ·  Red = action needed now.

panels.description: Count of registered data products matching current filters.
panels.title: Total Data Products

panels.description: Products with health score between 75% and 95% — watch closely.
panels.title: Degraded

panels.description: Products with health score below 75% — immediate attention required.
panels.title: Failed

panels.description: Average SLO compliance ratio across all filtered data products.
panels.title: SLO Compliance

panels.description: Products currently below healthy threshold (health score < 75%).
panels.title: Active Incidents

panels.description: Products whose data freshness exceeds 1 hour.
panels.title: Freshness Breaches

panels.description: One row per portfolio. Average health score, product count, SLO compliance and products in incident. Click the portfolio name to filter the rest of the dashboard.
panels.title: Portfolio Health Summary

panels.description: Average health score per portfolio. Green ≥ 95% · Yellow ≥ 75% · Red < 75%.
panels.title: Health Score by Portfolio

panels.description: Full product registry scoped to current filters. Red rows need immediate attention.
panels.title: Data Product Catalog — worst health first

panels.description: Matrix: each row = one data product, each column = one health dimension. Green = healthy, Yellow = warning, Red = critical. Scan rows to spot multi-dimension failures.
panels.title: Health Heatmap — Availability · Latency p95 · Freshness · Error Rate

panels.description: Total firing alerts across all products. Green = all clear. Yellow/Red = action required.
panels.title: Active Alerts

options.content:
**All Clear** — No critical alerts firing  ·  Last evaluated: every 30s

Stat panels above always show the live count. Table below lists each firing alert with full context. When no alerts are firing, all three counters read **0** and the table is intentionally empty.

panels.description: One row per firing alert. Empty = all products healthy. CRITICAL (red) requires immediate action; WARNING (yellow) requires monitoring.
panels.title: Firing Alerts — detail
